turn_boundaries.speaker: host_1
turn_boundaries.text: Now, when working with spherical mirrors, mastering the sign convention is non-negotiable. Alex, how do you remember the sign for object distance?

turn_boundaries.speaker: host_2
turn_boundaries.text: Since light travels from the left, any distance measured to the left of the pole is negative. So object distance u is always negative!

turn_boundaries.speaker: host_1
turn_boundaries.text: Exactly. And keep an eye on magnification: m equals negative v over u. A negative magnification instantly tells you the image is real and inverted.
